## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle commentary on the *Fànwǎng* bodhisattva-precepts by the Silla-dynasty Korean scholar **Sŭngjang** 勝莊 ([勝莊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8B%9D%E8%8E%8A)), composed during his Tang-period activity at Cháng'ān. The commentary represents a Yogācāra-Cí'ēn 慈恩 reading.

**Abstract**

Sŭngjang's commentary preserves the Yogācāra-influenced Tang-Silla scholastic interpretation of the bodhisattva-precepts. Sŭngjang himself participated in [義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8) Yìjìng's translation projects at Cháng'ān, giving him direct access to the late-Indian Mahāyāna *bodhisattva-vinaya* tradition that informs the commentary.
